name: fast-jev-compaction-local
description: Local hardened fast-jev compaction: Jev-only safe mode, conservative tool relevance scoring, result previews, sharded dialogue context, retries, and durable diagnostics.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool call, tool result, or old assistant text is still relevant; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to apply Jev output. Below it the session is left unchanged; this local fork never falls back to Claude summarization.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated ceiling for per-batch Jev state. Dialogue text is never abridged; hard-clamped below Jev's 32k state+longest-question limit.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated ceiling for one whole Jev request. Jev 1.13 allows 64k total; local fork keeps a safety margin.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

resultPreviewChars.title: Tool result preview for Jev
resultPreviewChars.description: Characters from each end of a tool result shown to Jev while judging informational relevance.

compactAssistantText.title: Compact old assistant text
compactAssistantText.description: Optional experimental scoring/removal of old assistant text. Disabled by default. When false, all user and assistant text is preserved verbatim and only tool calls/results are compacted.
